test "ownership/propagation/concat/u8/borrowed/next" {
    try check("export type Input = u8[]\n\nexport type Output = u64\n\nexport default function (in: Input): Output {\n  const owned: u8[] = [1]\n  const [next, _] = owned.concat(in)\n  const [reversed, _] = next.reverse()\n\n  return reversed.length\n\n}\n", .analyze, null, null);
}

test "ownership/propagation/splice/u8/borrowed/next" {
    try check("export type Input = u8[]\n\nexport type Output = u64\n\nexport default function (in: Input): Output {\n  const owned: u8[] = [1]\n  const [next, removed] = owned.splice(0, 0, in)\n  const [reversed, _] = next.reverse()\n\n  return reversed.length\n\n}\n", .analyze, null, null);
}
